Portfolio intro.paragraph: Twelve curated collections spanning the full guest journey — from the kitchen pass to the poolside bar.

Tile 3 sub.paragraph: Bar Items · Drinkware · Table Lamps · Indian

style.Portfolio: flex-direction: column; padding: 120px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)); gap: 64px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; @media(--tablet){ padding: 96px 40px; gap: 48px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 72px 20px; gap: 40px; } background: var(--on-cream);
style.Portfolio head: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 40px; z-index: 1; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 28px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; }
style.Portfolio head left: flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; padding: 0px; width: 700px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start;
style.Portfolio label row: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
style.Portfolio rule: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Portfolio label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #C9962E; line-height: 1.2;
style.Portfolio title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 60px; line-height: 62px; color: var(--on-navy); @media(--tablet){ font-size: 46px; line-height: 50px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 36px; line-height: 40px; }
style.Portfolio head right: flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 0px; width: 420px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start;
style.Portfolio intro: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 28px; color: var(--on-muted);
style.Portfolio tiles: padding: 0px; gap: 24px; @media(--tablet){ flex-wrap: wrap; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }
style.Tile 1: position: relative; overflow: hidden; height: 520px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; padding: 0px; background-color: #071F44; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7,31,68,0) 35%, rgba(7,31,68,0.92) 100%), url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/about-story-inset.jpg); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; @media(--tablet){ flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 12px); height: 440px; } @media(--mobile){ flex: 0 0 auto; width: 100%; height: 400px; }
style.Tile 1 caption: position: absolute; left: 32px; bottom: 32px; width: 340px; max-width: calc(100% - 64px); flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 0px; align-items: flex-start;
style.Tile 1 rule: width: 48px; min-width: 48px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Tile 1 title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 40px; line-height: 42px; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 34px; line-height: 38px; }
style.Tile 1 sub: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; line-height: 22px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
style.Tile 2: position: relative; overflow: hidden; height: 520px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; padding: 0px; background-color: #071F44; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7,31,68,0) 35%, rgba(7,31,68,0.92) 100%), url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/about-portfolio-buffet.jpg); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; @media(--tablet){ flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 12px); height: 440px; } @media(--mobile){ flex: 0 0 auto; width: 100%; height: 400px; }

style.Tile 2 title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 40px; line-height: 42px; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 34px; line-height: 38px; }
style.Tile 2 sub: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; line-height: 22px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);

style.Tile 3 rule: width: 48px; min-width: 48px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
